sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks Excel row 30 (#29); Internal Quality Checks Excel row 30 (#29); Quality Checks and Deterministic Checks inventories read and enumerated with frozen list_checks.py
.qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/rules/harbor-webdev-rubric-qc/references/staged-task-contract.md: prompt, judge, scoring and verifier contracts
evidence: Workbook Quality Checks row 30 (#29) and frozen quality-checks.md check 29 require the real render/constraints gates plus per-dimension zeroing. The older internal row says cross-origin apps hard-zero, but the public workbook, frozen skill Delivery profile, and current user policy explicitly supersede that annotation: public-network/off-origin assets must be accepted. The frozen task implements this: tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23-27 requires a usable workspace and a newly authored distinctive marker actually appearing in both preview and console after Run, not merely editor text or a sample. tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-29 requires successful UI save, observed server write, and same identity/title/filename/exact source through normal library UI in an independent clean context, then again after reload. Health/static JSON/localStorage alone cannot pass. Its prompt.md:24-33 gives a feasible browser_run_code_unsafe newContext lifecycle. Both gates are binary/all_pass (each judge.toml:14-21); tests/test.sh:213-229 executes gates and score.py before scored, and tests/tools/score.py:40-48 hard-zeros failed gates. All scored dimensions restate the in-dimension gate: functional/prompt.md:5 zeros the dimension on observed prerequisite failure; polish/prompt.md:13-22 assigns binary 0 to every criterion; visual/prompt.md:33-42 assigns raw Likert anchor 1, with the specified zero normalization at :48-50. Each requires a live usable workspace and server-supplied library data and relies on already-completed authored Run/independent readback; it does not repeat destructive gate work. No sign-in is appropriate (instruction.md:1, app_context.md:8). No same-origin condition is added (render/prompt.md:16, constraints/prompt.md:19-20, app_context.md:20); server-rendered records and arbitrary response representations are expressly accepted. app_context.md:16 prevents missing Auto-run from becoming an unrelated gate failure. Actual runtime feasibility was observed through MCP, not inferred from direct Playwright alone: row29-mcp-probe/command.json binds the input SHA and isolated no-network image; raw-mcp.json records initialize, tools/list with browser_run_code_unsafe, browser_navigate and tools/call. The callback response shows marker row29-mcp-1790834158048 in preview and console, a UI save HTTP 201 (id 1), null for the original-context storage sentinel in newContext(), and identical title/filename/source before and after reload with two server GET 200 responses containing id 1. It closed only the clean context and returned the original page. Host exit 0; duration 5.516 s is only probe duration. All 12 artifact hashes and all 50 source-binding file hashes were independently recomputed and matched. Raw MCP SHA256 b7da584facd9c3493abf6caf0fa8a43a54548892ca502e71b0258361bf49fac8; observations SHA256 ba10bfd001272d5f0db2f2d7cfdf6fadf6e6652dd1fe2b1d6fe49aff5067b181; artifact manifest SHA256 6e210c65471cac6c0340086452c434cec427f74ea8fe53264a539da97585ecec. Existing index hashes for cited golden, CLI-admission and tooling artifacts were also verified. Adversarial source review: a polished static sample with a no-op Run fails the fresh authored marker; a working editor with only localStorage persistence and a healthy/static JSON endpoint fails clean-context retrieval of a newly saved source. A conforming server-rendered library without JSON endpoints, CDN-backed editor assets, and an empty initial saved library is accepted by the explicit alternatives. These weak/conforming alternatives were reasoned against the gate text, not claimed as configured model runs. This Pass covers row-29 gate presence, semantics and tool feasibility only. No configured judge, empirical floor/ranking, Oracle, target-model or portal result was measured or inferred.
